text: 5 liters but it only accepts 2 cups in the dirty side. So guess what you are constantly lugging .... Heavy, clunky, have to fight the hose to the end - tool I really wanted to use on sofa is for "shag rugs" (honestly? in 2015?) and sprays you, the sofa, the floor and everything else in its path.  The tool that you can use does not have any bristles to really clean.  You can fill the clean water side up to about 1.5 liters but it only accepts 2 cups in the dirty side.  So guess what you are constantly lugging to the sink.  Dripping.  I should have just purchased the big upright like I used to have and use it on the furniture with its hose, worked like a charm just cost 300.00 more!
